latest_release.name: v2.3.2
latest_release.body:
## English

**Free Apple ID installs from S2Arm now start on their own.** S2Arm pushes the game resources into the app and used to launch the app once from the computer to unpack them. On a first install with a free Apple ID the developer is not trusted yet, that launch fails, and opening the app afterwards only said "Game resources not found". Now the app unpacks a pending push itself the first time you open it, with progress on screen, and then goes straight into the game. Nothing more is needed from the computer.

| Asset | For |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-s2arm-bundle.zip` | What S2Arm downloads: the 2.3.2 source, the iOS 26 shell and the prebuilt shader translator. Not for manual use |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | New iOS 26 shell ([NO_XCODE.md](docs/NO_XCODE.md)). Build input, not installable |

The iOS 18 shell, the Android APK and the HarmonyOS shell are unchanged: use the files from [v2.3.1](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/releases/tag/v2.3.1).

## 中文

**用免费 Apple ID 从 S2Arm 装的包，打开就能玩。** S2Arm 把游戏资源推进 App 后，原先要由电脑起一次 App 解包；免费 Apple ID 第一次装时开发者还没被信任，这一下起不来，之后打开只显示「没找到游戏资源」。现在 App 第一次打开时自己解开推来的资源（屏上显示进度），解完直接进游戏，不用再靠电脑。

| 附件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `D2RMobile-s2arm-bundle.zip` | S2Arm 下载的包件：2.3.2 源码、iOS 26 壳和预编的着色器翻译工具。不用手动使用 |
| `D2RMobile-shell-build-input.zip` | 新的 iOS 26 壳（[NO_XCODE.zh-CN.md](docs/NO_XCODE.zh-CN.md)）。是构建输入，不能直接安装 |

iOS 18 壳、安卓 APK、鸿蒙壳没有变化，用 [v2.3.1](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile/releases/tag/v2.3.1) 里的文件。
